context_for_next_testing_agent: Multitenancy Phase 2 fully validated. Key verifications: (1) GET /api/companies returns companies with stats (users_count, budgets_count, works_count, invoices_count), is_active, is_primary flags, (2) GET /api/companies/{id}/users returns users with has_access_to_company and is_primary_for_company flags, sorted by access status, (3) PUT /api/users/{id} accepts company_access_ids and company_id updates, (4) Users with multi-company access appear in both companies' user lists, (5) GET /api/users includes users with access to current tenant even if primary is different, (6) Primary company auto-added to access list if not present. Frontend: /empresas page shows 54 tenant cards with stats, edit buttons, and 'Gerir acessos' modal with toggle access checkboxes and 'Tornar principal' buttons. /utilizadores page shows user cards with accessible companies badges and edit dialog with multi-company access panel (54 company checkboxes) and primary company selector. CompanySwitcher shows 54 companies and switching works with toast notification. Tech portal shows company name in header.
features_tested: Admin can open /empresas and see visual tenant listing with data, stats, and active company
Admin can create a new company in /empresas and it appears in listing and global company selector
Admin can edit an existing company in /empresas and updated data persists via API
Access modal in /empresas (Acessos Multiempresa) lists manageable users with toggle access and set primary buttons
/utilizadores page shows and edits company_access_ids and company_id (primary company) with multi-company checkboxes and primary selector
GET /api/users remains isolated by active company but includes users with access to current tenant even when primary is different
PUT /api/users/{id} accepts company_access_ids and company_id updates without breaking auth or isolation
GET /api/companies returns detailed list with stats per tenant
GET /api/companies/{company_id}/users returns has_access_to_company and is_primary_for_company flags
CompanySwitcher continues to work after Phase 2 changes and new company can be selected globally
Tech portal continues without visible regressions after Phase 2
